zh: 週一（11/23）美股大幅反彈：標普 500 收 7,237.17 點（+4.73%）、那斯達克收 24,089.56 點（+6.51%），兩者都是 2025 年 4 月以來單日最大漲幅；道瓊收 49,595.31 點，大漲 1,447.98 點（+3.01%）。這一天抹掉上週約一半的跌幅，上週那斯達克單週跌約 10%、是 2020 年 3 月以來最慘的一週。CNBC 與美聯社的收盤數字一致。短線上漲不代表趨勢翻轉：BTIG 的 Krinsky 預期先反彈到 7,250 至 7,350 再轉弱，Barclays 則認為這波 AI 賣壓可能「殺過頭」。
en: US stocks rebounded sharply on Monday, Nov. 23. The S&P 500 closed at 7,237.17 (+4.73%) and the Nasdaq Composite at 24,089.56 (+6.51%), both the biggest one-day gains since April 2025; the Dow closed at 49,595.31, up 1,447.98 points (+3.01%). The move erased roughly half of last week's losses, when the Nasdaq fell about 10%, its worst week since March 2020. CNBC and the AP agree on the closing figures. A bounce is not a trend reversal: BTIG's Krinsky expects a rally to 7,250-7,350 before another turn lower, while Barclays says the AI sell-off may have gone too far.

zh: 引爆反彈的是 Nvidia：董事會宣布黃仁勳即刻復任執行長，股價收漲約 31.5%，接近 2000 年以來最大單日漲幅，並帶動費半 ETF（SMH）盤中漲逾 16%。黃仁勳 11/12 因報導中的私人醜聞辭職，美聯社指出董事會仍在調查他是否成為間諜目標與國安疑慮；川普公開表示他「沒做錯事」。Melius、Bernstein、StoneX 同日調升評等，目標價 200 至 270 美元不等。Nvidia 一個月內仍累計跌約 39%，這根大陽線是在深跌之後出現的。
en: The spark was Nvidia: its board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO effective immediately and the stock closed up about 31.5%, near its best day since 2000, lifting the semiconductor ETF SMH by more than 16% intraday. Huang resigned on Nov. 12 after reported personal scandals; the AP says the board is still probing whether he was a target of espionage and any national-security concerns, while President Trump said he 'did nothing wrong'. Melius, Bernstein and StoneX raised ratings the same day with targets of $200-$270. Nvidia is still down about 39% over the past month, so this rally follows a deep drop.

stocks.n: 週一收漲約 31.5%，因黃仁勳復任執行長
費半 ETF 盤中漲逾 16%，接近 2025/4/9 以來最大單日漲幅

zh: AI 供應鏈個股跟著 Nvidia 大幅反彈：美光（MU）漲約 19%、CoreWeave（CRWV）漲約 22%、AMD 漲近 7%，Alphabet（GOOGL）與 Meta（META）各漲約 6%，微軟漲逾 1%。記憶體尤其強，Roundhill 記憶體 ETF 漲逾 19%，SK 海力士漲約 21%。這是上週大跌之後的修復行情，漲幅比基本面消息來得快，隔天能不能守住要看資金是否持續回流。
en: AI supply-chain names rebounded alongside Nvidia: Micron (MU) rose about 19%, CoreWeave (CRWV) about 22%, AMD nearly 7%, Alphabet (GOOGL) and Meta (META) about 6% each, and Microsoft more than 1%. Memory was especially strong, with Roundhill's memory ETF up more than 19% and SK Hynix up about 21%. This is a repair rally after last week's plunge, moving faster than any fundamental news, so whether it holds depends on continued inflows.

stocks.n: 美光漲約 19%，記憶體族群領漲

zh: 股市大漲的同一天，金屬也大漲：黃金期貨約 +4%、白銀約 +5%、銅約 +3%，礦業股跟著上揚。能源方向相反，布蘭特原油下跌 3.6% 至每桶 86.68 美元（2 月美以攻擊伊朗後一路在 72 至 114 美元間震盪）；10 年期美債殖利率 4.93%，只比週五的 4.92% 高一點。海外有分歧：韓國 Kospi 逆勢跌 3.31% 收 4,708.54，歐洲 Stoxx 600 收盤漲逾 1%。
en: Metals rallied alongside stocks: gold futures rose about 4%, silver about 5% and copper about 3%, lifting miners. Energy went the other way: Brent fell 3.6% to $86.68 a barrel (it has ranged between $72 and $114 since the US and Israel attacked Iran in February), and the 10-year Treasury yield was 4.93% versus 4.92% on Friday. Overseas was mixed: South Korea's Kospi fell 3.31% to 4,708.54 while Europe's Stoxx 600 closed up more than 1%.

zh: 網路資安出現大併購：CrowdStrike（CRWD）宣布以約 439 億美元全股票收購 Zscaler（ZS），合併後 CrowdStrike 股東約持有 84.1%。市場反應分歧：Zscaler 週一漲約 13% 至 18%（不同來源數字不同），CrowdStrike 跌約 8% 至 9%，是典型的收購方折價、被收購方溢價。這則消息發生在大盤普漲的一天，所以 CrowdStrike 的下跌更值得注意：市場在替整合風險與全股票稀釋定價。
en: A big cybersecurity deal: CrowdStrike (CRWD) said it will buy Zscaler (ZS) in an all-stock transaction valued at about $43.9 billion, leaving CrowdStrike holders with roughly 84.1% of the combined company. The reaction was split: Zscaler rose about 13% to 18% (sources differ) while CrowdStrike fell about 8% to 9%, the classic acquirer discount and target premium. It happened on a day when the whole market rallied, so CrowdStrike's drop stands out: investors are pricing integration risk and the dilution from an all-stock deal.

stocks.n: 被收購方，週一約 +13% 至 +18%

zh: 兩檔 AI 伺服器股在財報前先大漲：247 Wall St. 的名單顯示 Dell 週一約 +20.5%、HPE 約 +17.4%（盤中時間點未標示，數字請與行情軟體核對）。HPE 於週一盤後公布財報，CNBC 提到它本月已跌約 25%；Dell 週二盤後公布，本月已跌約 34%。我沒有查到 HPE 的實際財報結果與盤後反應，所以只能說：兩家都是在大幅回檔後被一口氣拉回，財報成為下一個檢驗。
en: Two AI-server stocks jumped ahead of their reports: 247 Wall St.'s list shows Dell up about 20.5% and HPE about 17.4% on Monday (the intraday timing is not labeled, so check a terminal). HPE reported after the bell on Monday; CNBC notes it had fallen about 25% this month, while Dell reports Tuesday after the close after a roughly 34% drop in November. I could not find HPE's actual results or its after-hours reaction, so all that can be said is that both were pulled up sharply after deep declines, and earnings are the next test.

stocks.n: 週一約 +20.5%，週二盤後公布財報
週一約 +17.4%，週一盤後公布財報

zh: Oracle（ORCL）週一漲約 12%，原因是公司在週五收盤後發聲明，表示與 OpenAI 運算合約的資金已經到位。此前 Oracle 股價已比高點跌近七成，市場主要擔心它的 AI 資料中心債務與資金來源。CoreWeave（CRWV）同日漲約 22%；美聯社與 CNBC 都提到，高殖利率讓 AI 基建的借款更困難，所以「資金有著落」本身就是題材。聲明不等於財報，後續仍要看負債與現金流的實際數字。
en: Oracle (ORCL) rose about 12% on Monday after a statement issued following Friday's close said funding is in place for its OpenAI compute deal. Its stock had fallen nearly 70% from its peak on worries about AI data-center debt and funding. CoreWeave (CRWV) gained about 22% the same day; both the AP and CNBC note that high yields make AI build-out borrowing harder, so 'funding secured' is itself the story. A statement is not an earnings report, and debt and cash flow still need to be checked.

stocks.n: 週一約 +12%，稱 OpenAI 合約資金到位
週一約 +22%，新興雲端業者，融資敏感

zh: 標普全球的 11 月 PMI 初值顯示景氣仍擴張但降溫：製造業 53.7（10 月 54.5，為三個月低點）、服務業 54.7（10 月 56.1，為四個月低點）。市場原本預期製造業約 54.5、服務業約 55.6，所以兩項都略低於預期。在升息預期尚未退場的情況下，數據降溫可以讀成「通膨壓力減輕」，也可以讀成「需求在走弱」，要看週三的 PCE 與 GDP 才分得出來。
en: S&P Global's flash November PMIs show activity still expanding but cooling: manufacturing 53.7 (October 54.5, a three-month low) and services 54.7 (October 56.1, a four-month low). Forecasts were about 54.5 and 55.6, so both came in a little light. With rate-hike expectations still alive, cooler data can be read as easing inflation pressure or as weakening demand, and Wednesday's PCE and GDP are needed to tell which.

stocks.n: 大盤，PMI 數據降溫但仍在 50 以上

zh: 紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯（Williams）週一下午 4:00 發表貨幣政策展望談話，heygotrade 的週報提到市場想從中找 12 月決策的線索，核心 PCE 若偏熱可能再添升息擔憂。我在本次可讀的頁面中沒有查到威廉斯談話的實際內容，也沒查到 CME FedWatch 的升息機率，因此不寫機率數字；先前的紀錄是下次 FOMC 會議在 12/9。這一則先當成「待核對事項」，請回到 Fed 官網或 FedWatch 看實際內容。
en: New York Fed President John Williams spoke on monetary policy at 4:00 p.m. Monday, and the heygotrade weekly says markets were looking for clues on the December decision, with a hot core PCE potentially adding to worries about more hikes. I could not find the content of his remarks or CME FedWatch hike odds in the pages I could read, so I am not quoting a probability; the next FOMC meeting was earlier noted as Dec. 9. Treat this as an item to verify against the Fed's site or FedWatch.

stocks.n: 金融類股 ETF，利率路徑敏感
區域銀行 ETF，對升息預期敏感

zh: 貿易與地緣訊號同時出現：川普表示中國將再買 250 架波音飛機，波音（BA）週一漲逾 4%；另外 Coterra（CTRA）下跌約 8.6%，與布蘭特原油下跌 3.6% 一致。美聯社提到，2 月美以攻擊伊朗後布蘭特一路在 72 至 114 美元之間，目前 86.68 美元算中段。這類消息多來自川普的公開說法，簽約與交機時程要等公司或中方確認再看。
en: Trade and geopolitics both showed up: President Trump said China would buy 250 more Boeing jets, and Boeing (BA) rose more than 4% on Monday; separately Coterra (CTRA) fell about 8.6%, in line with Brent's 3.6% drop. The AP notes Brent has ranged between $72 and $114 since the US and Israel attacked Iran in February, so $86.68 is mid-range. Such news largely comes from the President's own statements, and contract and delivery timing should be confirmed by the companies or Beijing.

stocks.n: 週一漲逾 4%，因川普稱中國將再買 250 架

zh: 板塊中最強的是半導體：VanEck 半導體 ETF（SMH）盤中漲逾 16%，已接近 2025 年 4 月 9 日漲 17.16% 的最大單日紀錄；科技類股 ETF（XLK）漲逾 10%，也追近同日的 13.43%。記憶體是最亮的一塊，美光漲約 19%。極端的單日漲幅常常出現在極端的單週下跌之後，所以先把它看成「超賣修復」而不是新趨勢。
en: The strongest sector was semiconductors: the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) was up more than 16% at one point, near its record one-day gain of 17.16% on April 9, 2025, and the technology sector ETF (XLK) rose more than 10% versus 13.43% that day. Memory was the brightest spot, with Micron up about 19%. Extreme one-day gains often follow extreme weekly losses, so treat this first as an oversold repair, not a new trend.

zh: 工業與電力設備跟著反彈：GE Vernova（GEV）漲約 8.2%、Caterpillar（CAT）漲約 7.2%，兩者在前一週分別跌近 13% 與 15%。這兩檔的邏輯和 AI 資料中心的電力需求有關，所以會跟著 AI 情緒一起大跌大漲。波音則因川普稱中國將再買 250 架而漲逾 4%，屬於另一條獨立的題材。
en: Industrials and power equipment rebounded: GE Vernova (GEV) rose about 8.2% and Caterpillar (CAT) about 7.2%, after falling nearly 13% and 15% the previous week. Both are tied to power demand from AI data centers, so they swing with AI sentiment. Boeing rose more than 4% on Trump's claim that China will buy 250 more jets, a separate story.

zh: 貴金屬與基本金屬一起走高：金價約 +4%、銀約 +5%、銅約 +3%，Newmont（NEM）等礦業股受惠。股市與黃金同日大漲，表示當天的買盤不是單純的避險，而是風險偏好回升加上實質利率預期的調整。我沒有查到黃金現貨價格，只引用期貨漲幅；礦業股的後續要看 11/25 的 PCE 與美元走勢。
en: Precious and base metals rose together: gold about 4%, silver about 5% and copper about 3%, helping miners such as Newmont (NEM). Stocks and gold both surging on the same day suggests buying was not just a flight to safety but also a pickup in risk appetite and a shift in real-rate expectations. I did not find a spot gold price and only cite futures moves; follow-through depends on Wednesday's PCE and the dollar.

zh: 這則是判讀，不是行情。週一我沒有查到羅素 2000 的確切收盤：247 Wall St. 盤前表中追蹤它的 ETF 約 +3%，頁首有一個 2,673.97（+3.05%）的數字但沒有時間戳記，所以只能當未確認。判讀小型股反彈要分開看：一是大型科技修復帶動的風險偏好，二是小型股自己的利率敏感度（多數公司舉債是浮動利率）。後者要等 PCE 與 12 月 FOMC 才會明朗。
en: This is a reading note, not a market report. I could not find an exact Russell 2000 close for Monday: 247 Wall St.'s premarket table shows a tracking ETF up about 3%, and a header figure of 2,673.97 (+3.05%) carries no timestamp, so treat it as unconfirmed. Read a small-cap bounce in two parts: risk appetite lifted by the large-cap tech repair, and small caps' own rate sensitivity (most carry floating-rate debt). The latter becomes clearer after PCE and the December FOMC.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，盤前約 +3%（未確認收盤）
標普小型 600 ETF，不同編製的對照

zh: 比特幣相關股在盤前先反彈：Mara（MARA）漲約 7.6%、Strategy（MSTR）漲約 8.5%，CNBC 說比特幣正試圖收復上週的大幅虧損。這類公司的股價等於把比特幣價格加上槓桿，漲跌幅通常比幣價本身大；Mara 屬中型股、波動大。我沒有查到比特幣的確切價格，因此只能寫方向，不寫數字。
en: Bitcoin-linked stocks bounced in premarket trading: Mara (MARA) rose about 7.6% and Strategy (MSTR) about 8.5%, with CNBC saying bitcoin was trying to recover steep losses from last week. These stocks are effectively leveraged bets on bitcoin, so their moves tend to exceed the coin's; Mara is a mid-cap with high volatility. I did not find an exact bitcoin price, so I can give direction but no figure.

stocks.n: 盤前約 +8.5%，持有大量比特幣的公司

zh: Baird 把 Citizens Financial（CFG）與 Truist（TFC）調升為優於大盤，兩檔盤前都漲逾 2%；它們屬於中型或偏大型的區域銀行，是小型股池子之外、與利率路徑關係最深的族群。升評的時間點落在升息預期仍高的時候，值得觀察是否會被 PCE 反轉。我沒有查到 Baird 的目標價或理由，這則只能提供事實，不能推論它的邏輯。
en: Baird upgraded Citizens Financial (CFG) and Truist (TFC) to outperform, and both rose more than 2% in premarket trading. They are mid-to-large regional banks, outside the small-cap pool but closely tied to the rate path. The upgrades came while hike expectations remain elevated, and it is worth watching whether PCE reverses them. I did not find Baird's targets or reasoning, so this card gives the fact but not the logic.

stocks.n: Baird 調升為優於大盤，盤前漲逾 2%
Baird 調升為優於大盤，盤前漲逾 2%

zh: International Paper（IP）週一下跌約 4% 至 4.5%，原因是董事會核准把歐洲、中東與非洲的包裝業務（來自 DS Smith）分拆出去。分拆通常是為了讓兩個部分被各自估值，但短期會有一次性成本與投資人換股壓力。這屬於中型股的「結構性事件」，要等分拆時程、債務分配與新公司的獨立財報才能判斷價值。
en: International Paper (IP) fell about 4% to 4.5% on Monday after its board approved spinning off its EMEA packaging business, which came with the DS Smith acquisition. Spinoffs aim to let two parts be valued separately, but near-term there are one-time costs and shareholder churn. This is a mid-cap structural event, and its value depends on the timetable, debt allocation and the new company's standalone financials.

stocks.n: 週一約 -4% 至 -4.5%，核准分拆 EMEA 包裝業務

zh: 大漲日也有逆行者：Elevance Health（ELV）約 -3.8%、Texas Pacific Land（TPL）約 -3.5%、Coterra（CTRA）約 -8.6%；Anthropic（ANT）的消息互相矛盾，CNBC 說午後約 -3%，247 說盤前約 +4%，報價框顯示 87.64 美元（-1.43%），所以不能下定論。把這些個股放在一起看，是為了提醒：大盤漲 4.7% 的日子仍有一批股票沒有跟上。
en: Even on a big up day some stocks went the other way: Elevance Health (ELV) about -3.8%, Texas Pacific Land (TPL) about -3.5% and Coterra (CTRA) about -8.6%. Reports on Anthropic (ANT) conflict: CNBC says it was down about 3% in the afternoon, 247 says it was up about 4% premarket, and its quote box shows $87.64 (-1.43%), so no conclusion can be drawn. The point of grouping them is that a 4.7% market gain still left a number of stocks behind.

stocks.n: 各來源矛盾：CNBC 約 -3%、247 盤前約 +4%

zh: Solaris Energy Infrastructure（SEI，NYSE）：做模組化發電、配電設備，賣給資料中心與能源客戶，另有油田物流事業。InsiderPrint 顯示 4 名內部人在 11/9 至 11/20 合計買進約 74.8 萬美元，包括執行長 Amanda Brock 約 26.9 萬、董事長 Zartler 約 21.2 萬，均價約 54.37 美元。什麼正在改變：Q3（11/5 公布）調高財測並新增電力合約，逐字稿提到一份 900 MW、15 年期合約與逾 160 億美元積壓訂單；2025 年營收年增約 99%。為什麼被忽視：其實不算被忽視，有 14 位分析師、共識偏強烈買進、目標價約 107.77 美元，股價 61.23 美元，距 52 週區間 40.38 至 86.19 的上緣不遠也不近；所以它是「內部人加碼」而不是「雙重忽視」。風險：9 月發了 12.5 億美元 7% 利率的高級債券，債務與資料中心景氣是關鍵。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Solaris Energy Infrastructure (SEI, NYSE) makes modular power generation and distribution equipment for data centers and energy customers, plus oilfield logistics. InsiderPrint shows four insiders bought about $748,000 between Nov. 9 and Nov. 20, including CEO Amanda Brock (about $269,000) and chair Zartler (about $212,000), at an average of about $54.37. What is changing: Q3 results (Nov. 5) raised guidance and added power contracts, with the transcript citing a 900 MW, 15-year contract and more than $16 billion of backlog; 2025 revenue rose about 99%. Why neglected: it is not really neglected, with 14 analysts, a strong-buy consensus and a $107.77 average target, so this is insider buying rather than a double-neglect case; the stock is $61.23 against a 52-week range of $40.38-$86.19. Risk: a $1.25 billion 7% senior note issue in September, so debt and data-center demand matter. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: 4 人買進約 74.8 萬美元，均價約 54.37；收盤 61.23

status: RADAR · 下一個驗證點 讀 Form 4 與下次財報

zh: Contango Silver & Gold（CTGO，NYSE American）：阿拉斯加與加拿大黃金三角區的金銀探勘與生產公司，3 月由 Contango Ore 改名，只有約 6 名員工。InsiderPrint 顯示 3 名內部人在 11/17 至 11/19 合計買進約 47.3 萬美元（董事 Juneau 約 29.6 萬、執行長 Van Nieuwenhuyse 約 10.1 萬），均價約 10.56 美元。什麼正在改變：11/18 公布 Lucky Shot 鑽探結果 3.92 公尺含金 62.97 g/t；逐字稿說 2026 年是低產量、高成本的一年，但沒有增資計畫，2027 年有資源量估算與可行性研究。股價 9.98 美元，接近 52 週低點 9.37（高點 34.38）。風險：近 12 個月虧損約 5,655 萬美元、還沒有營收數字；7 位分析師共識買進、目標價 28.33 美元只是參考。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Contango Silver & Gold (CTGO, NYSE American) explores and produces gold and silver in Alaska and British Columbia's Golden Triangle; it was renamed from Contango Ore in March and has about six employees. InsiderPrint shows three insiders bought about $473,000 between Nov. 17 and Nov. 19 (director Juneau about $296,000, CEO Van Nieuwenhuyse about $101,000) at an average of about $10.56. What is changing: a Nov. 18 drill result of 62.97 g/t gold over 3.92 m at Lucky Shot; the transcript calls 2026 a low-production, high-cost year but says no equity raise is planned, with a resource estimate and feasibility study planned for 2027. en: CorMedix (CRMD, Nasdaq; added to the radar pool on Sept. 2) sells DefenCath, a catheter lock solution for kidney-failure patients, plus Rezzayo. zh: 判讀這類叢集買進，先看三件事。一是金額相對規模：ARR 的 3 人合計約 9.1 萬美元、ITG 的 5 人合計約 120 萬美元，金額差十倍以上，訊號強度不同；二是時間：ITG 的 5 人全部在 11/13 同一天買進，像是一次協調好的動作，而 ARR 分散在 11/13 至 11/20；三是來源，InsiderPrint 這類整理是第三方，必須回 SEC 的 Form 4 原件核對。昨日的紀錄也提過資料站之間會彼此矛盾，所以每次上卡都附上這句提醒。
en: Three checks help when reading cluster buys. First, size relative to the company: ARR's three insiders bought about $91,000 in total while ITG's five bought about $1.2 million, more than ten times as much, so signal strength differs. Second, timing: all five ITG insiders bought on the same day, Nov. 13, which looks coordinated, whereas ARR's buys were spread across Nov. 13-20. Third, source: an aggregator like InsiderPrint is a third party, so always verify against the SEC Form 4s. Data sites have also contradicted each other before, which is why this reminder is repeated.

zh: 判讀政要申報，記住幾個限制。一，法定申報期限最長 45 天，所以你看到的是別人一個半月前的價位；二，金額只有寬區間，沒有精確數字，像 Maria Salazar（FL27）27 筆交易合計只標示約 9.7 萬至 58 萬美元；三，帳戶可能是配偶或信託，不一定是議員本人下單；四，官方 PDF 有些是掃描檔，我的統計跳過了 15 份，所以名單並不完整。這頻道不暗示任何內線，也不構成跟單建議，只是看有人用真錢押哪些主題。
en: A few limits apply when reading congressional filings. One, the legal deadline is up to 45 days, so you see prices from a month and a half ago; two, amounts are only wide ranges, for example Maria Salazar (FL27) shows 27 trades with a combined range of only about $97,000 to $580,000; three, the account may belong to a spouse or trust rather than the member; four, some official PDFs are scanned, and my tally skipped 15, so the roster is incomplete. This channel implies nothing about inside information and is not a copy-trade suggestion; it only shows what themes people are putting real money behind.

en: Thanksgiving week has only three regular trading days: markets are closed Thursday Nov. 26 and close early at 1:00 p.m. on Friday Nov. 27. Tuesday at 10:00 brings consumer confidence (forecast 92.1, prior 91.7); Wednesday at 8:30 brings October core PCE (forecast +0.3% m/m, prior +0.3%), the second estimate of Q3 GDP (forecast 3.5%, first 3.4%), weekly jobless claims (forecast 201,000) and October durable goods, with the Fed's Beige Book at 2:00 p.m. With thin volume, one surprise number can amplify moves.

zh: 今天最值得注意的一件事：週一 4.7% 的單日反彈，幾乎全由 Nvidia 的人事消息與 AI 供應鏈的修復買盤推動，而不是新的經濟或獲利資訊。週五的賣壓有估值與政策的成分（升息預期、殖利率接近 5%），也有 Nvidia 治理的成分；前者週三的 PCE 才會驗證，後者靠一則人事公告只算暫時降溫，董事會對調查的說法仍未定案。問題：如果週二 Dell 財報與週三 PCE 都只是「普通」，市場會把這根大陽線看成底部，還是下一波下跌前的喘息？
en: The one thing worth watching today: Monday's 4.7% rebound was driven almost entirely by Nvidia's leadership news and repair buying in the AI supply chain, not by new economic or earnings information. Friday's selling had a valuation-and-policy component (hike expectations, yields near 5%) and a Nvidia-governance component; Wednesday's PCE will test the former, while a personnel announcement only temporarily cools the latter, with the board's investigation still unresolved. The question: if Tuesday's Dell report and Wednesday's PCE are merely 'ordinary', will the market read this big up day as a bottom or as a pause before the next leg down?
